EC1: Clinically significant systemic disease (such as diabetes [OR], metabolic syndrome [OR], immunological diseases [OR], diagnosed thrombophilia [OR], porphyria [OR], or any other medical condition [AND] requiring the use of low-molecular weight heparin therapy)
EC2: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) according to Rotterdam Consensus Criteria (European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology [ESHRE]/American Society for Reproductive Medicine [ASRM], 2003)
EC3: Poor ovarian response (POR) according to the European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology (ESHRE) Criteria
EC4: RIF (repeated implantation failure) [AND], defined as greater than or equals to (>=) 2 previous failed embryo transfers
EC6: Clinically significant findings on exam [OR] or ultrasound, such as salpingitis [OR], hydrosalpynx [OR] or evidence of ovarian cysts
EC7: Known hypersensitivity [AND] to any of the components of the solution
EC8: Known hypersensitivity [AND] to vaginal progesterone [OR] or its excipients
EC9: Other protocol defined exclusion criteria could apply
